question: 87-year-old Ramlal Bareth, the only surviving Kathak Dancer of Raigarh court, was awarded with which of the following awards in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Ramlal Bareth**, an 87-year-old Kathak dancer, is the last surviving exponent of the Raigarh court's classical dance tradition.
 
• He was recognized with the **Padma Shri award in 2024** for his contributions to Indian classical dance.
